text.en:
Barangays Sugod, Langbaybay, Baguin, Mataloto, Guimbarocan, Polangabto, Pantalan,
Balocawe, Nipa, Luna and San Vicente, all comprising the whole island of Tagapul-an and forming part of
Municipality of Almagro, Province of Western Samar, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form
and constitute into a district and independent municipality which is created to be known as the Municipality of
Tagapul-an, without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother municipality of Almagro. The
seat of government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Sugod.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or thereafter applicable to regular
municipalities, shall be applicable to the municipality of Tagapul-an.

The present elective officials of the Municipality of Almagro shall perform their duties as such
in the newly created municipality until the officials of the latter shall have been duly appointed by the
President and they shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the election for provincial
and municipal officials following the issuance of this decree, and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed
at the pleasure of the President. Other officials and employees necessary in the organization and operation of
the municipal government shall be appointed in the manner provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the new municipality of
Tagapul-an in the obligations, funds, assets and other property of Almagro shall be transferred by the
President to the newly created municipality upon recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders and regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 15th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Six.
